additional_info.subject: FW: Siemens Sicharge
additional_info.body:
Goedendag,
Zie onderstaande melding over een storing voor Siemens Sicharge D van Van der Haak. Onderstaand het serienummer van het laadstation.
Zouden jullie het laadstation kunnen uitlezen voor foutmeldingen en een oplossing richting kunnen aangeven.
Indien er vragen zijn verneem ik deze graag. Alvast dank.
Met vriendelijke groet,
With kind regards,
Jordy Keimes
Chief Sustainability Officer
0345-544642
|
06-89921185
Jordy.Keimes@dijkauto.nl
dijkauto.nl
VAN DIJK WOERDEN
Rosmolenlaan 5
3447 GL Woerden
﻿
Hallo Luuk,
Zoals besproken, hierbij de info over de vermoedelijke storing in onze DC-lader.
Sinds 7 januari jl. laad de dc-lader niet meer door en breek het proces al na 1 uur af.
Zie hiervoor logfiles van E-flux. Normaal werd er 170 kWh tot 200 kWh bijgeladen. Vanaf 7 januari ’25 werd dit 125 kWh of minder.
Opnieuw het laadproces starten door de auto te ontgrendelen en de kabel opnieuw te verbinden was voldoende om door te laden. Dit hebben we soms meerdere keren moeten doen.
Zie logfile.
In Optifleet staat ook dat de lader een fout geeft. Zie de foutmelding van 11-1-25 (accu op 70%), maar ook nog op 13-1-25 (accu op 100%).
Gisterenmorgen om 9:00 uur heb ik via E-flux de Siemens Sicharge een herstart commando gegeven. Het ziet er nu naar uit dat de accu wel wordt doorgeladen.
Vanmorgen is de sessie gestart en er is in één keer 193 kWh geladen. Batterij op 100%. Mogelijk doordat er gisteren een herstart heeft plaatsgevonden.
Wel vreemd dat wij gisterenmiddag nog steeds een foutmelding zien in Optifleet.
Laat maar even weten of jullie hierin iets kunnen betekenen of dat wij dit in eerste instantie bij Siemens moeten melden?
Met vriendelijke groet,
Derk van den Haak
T: +31 (0)345 585463
M: +31 (0)610 954748

Problem Description

I wanted to provide you with some clarity regarding the power delivery of the charger which is based on the EV's demand. For example, if the EV requests a current of 200A and the voltage is 700V, the charger will deliver approximately 140kW of power.
Upon reviewing the charging logs from January 7th, we found that most of the charging sessions were unsuccessful due to a V2G error. However, there was one session that was successfully completed. In that particular session, the EV was demanding 140kW, which is why the charger was delivering lower power than expected.
I hope this explanation helps clarify the situation. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any further questions or need additional information.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399854-DC/Si-D/NL-[Y2/S9 313873507001] Charger delivering low power CRM:01811000580
additional_info.body:
Hi Ankita,
Thanks for the information. The problem with the charger is not only the power output, but the charging sessions are stopped while the truck is not yet at 100% charged.
It stops at different SOC and amounts of charged kW, there is no pattern in it.
As shown below sessions.
Start: 10 Jan 2025, 09:17
End: 10 Jan 2025, 10:04
SOC 80%
Start: 10 Jan 2025, 10:47
End: 10 Jan 2025, 11:00
SOC 89%
Start: 10 Jan 2025, 11:45
End: 10 Jan 2025, 11:56
SOC 94%
On earlier days, for example, it stopped at 67% the first time.`
Yesterday morning at 9:00 a.m., the customer gave the Siemens Sicharge a restart command via E-flux. It now looks like the battery is being charged.
yesterday the session started and 193 kWh was charged in one go. Battery at 100%. Possibly because a restart took place yesterday.
But we would like to know if the date reflects what the malfunction could be if it happens again.
can you provide us with information for the customer. Thank you in advance.
Best regards
Met vriendelijke groet,
With kind regards,
Jordy Keimes
Chief Sustainability Officer

additional_info.subject: All chargings sessions were failed With same EV. on 10th  Jan
RE: ID0399854-DC/Si-D/NL-[Y2/S9 313873507001] Charger delivering low power CRM:01811000580
additional_info.body:
Hello Jordy,
I would like to clarify the difference between a "working" session and a "non-working" session for your reference:
Working Session
: P001 >> P002
Non-working Session
: P001
For the issue you are experiencing, we kindly request that you provide a video showing that the RFID is being provided but is not being recognized by the system. If this issue is confirmed, we will escalate the matter to our regional colleagues for further troubleshooting and resolution.
Regarding the session on January 10th, we were unable to recover the charging controller logs due to space limitations on the controller, which meant that the logs were temporary and no longer available. Based on the information we could gather, it appears that the EV lost communication with the EVSE.
We also noticed that all the charging sessions have failed with the same EV. To help narrow down the issue, could you please try charging with a different EV and let us know if the problem persists? This will help us determine if the issue is related to the specific EV.
If you encounter a similar problem in the future, where charging stops abruptly, please inform us immediately so that we can investigate further and address the issue promptly.
Thank you for your cooperation.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
